title: Klarna reports Q4 revenue up 38% YoY to $1.08B and a $26M net loss, down from a $40M profit in Q4 2024; KLAR is down 50%+ since its September 2025 NYSE IPO (Laith Al-Khalaf/Financial Times)
summary: Laith Al-Khalaf / Financial Times: Klarna reports Q4 revenue up 38% YoY to $1.08B and a $26M net loss, down from a $40M profit in Q4 2024; KLAR is down 50%+ since its September 2025 NYSE IPO — Swedish fintech's shares have sunk since September's IPO — Klarna swung to a $26mn net loss in the last three months of 2025 …
contentText:
Laith Al-Khalaf / Financial Times :

Klarna reports Q4 revenue up 38% YoY to $1.08B and a $26M net loss, down from a $40M profit in Q4 2024; KLAR is down 50%+ since its September 2025 NYSE IPO   —  Swedish fintech's shares have sunk since September's IPO  —  Klarna swung to a $26mn net loss in the last three months of 2025 …
